items.summary: Aston Villa extended their perfect Champions League campaign with a confident 3-1 victory over Viking at Villa Park, with Ross Barkley and Emiliano Buendia both finding the net as the Villans became the first Europa League holders to win their opening three Champions League games since Manchester United in 2017-18.

source.title: Aston Villa 3-1 Viking: Emery's side stay perfect in Champions League

items.summary: Summer signing Johan Manzambi has been a revelation for Villa, registering five goal contributions in his last four appearances across all competitions, with his impressive form reportedly attracting interest from Barcelona and Bayern Munich.

source.title: Ever-improving Johan Manzambi embodies Aston Villa’s new direction after summer rebuild

items.summary: Injury concerns mount for Unai Emery with Manzambi picking up a minor knock, Matteo Ruggeri expected to miss around two months, and Aaron Wan-Bissaka sidelined for three to four weeks, though Ian Maatsen has returned to training.

source.title: Emery and Aston Villa not underestimating 'dangerous' Viking
